apps.name: SideInstaller
apps.subtitle: An an app that installs Sidestore on iOS 27, fully on-device
apps.localizedDescription: Install SideStore and LiveContainer directly on your iPhone. No PC required.
apps.versionDescription:
### Changed
- **lillq is the first anisette server.** anisette.lillq.me, a pool of anisette servers that checks every hour which clients Apple lets through, is now on the list in Settings › Anisette Server, and a first sign-in starts there. With Auto on, it comes right after the server that signed in last and the others that share its anisette identity, which keep the saved sign-in.

### Fixed
- **Signing in to Apple works again.** Since 20 November Apple has answered sign-ins through every Mac anisette server with HTTP 503 (#146–#161), turning away any client that calls its system “macOS”. SideInstaller now signs in as a Mac on macOS 10.15.7, the newest that still calls itself “Mac OS X”, which Apple lets through and which is new enough for the accounts that need macOS 10.13 or later.
- **The device link finds the pairing port when it isn't 49152.** When 49152 refuses and the port the iPhone advertises doesn't answer either, SideInstaller knocks on the iPhone's other ports, 32 at a time, and opens the link on the one that answers as its pairing listener, as siboot 0.19.1 does.
- **The device link no longer waits for ever on a port something else holds.** Each port is asked for the pairing handshake first (8 s to connect, 10 s to answer), and one that doesn't answer as the pairing listener is passed over.

apps.name: Nightflix
apps.subtitle: An iOS movie and series streaming app
apps.versionDescription:
Nightflix 3.0 is a complete redesign.

- New Netflix-style interface: Home with Series / Films / Categories filters, a featured title, Top 10 rows, Continue Watching and "Because You Watched" rows
- New & Hot tab: Coming Soon with release reminders, Everyone's Watching, and today's Top 10 series and films
- My Nightflix tab: Continue Watching, My List, titles you've rated, reminders and recently watched
- Tap a title for a quick preview, or open its full page with episodes, More Like This and trailers
- Search also finds titles by actor
- New built-in player (VidFast) with resume and episode autoplay
- The player opens in landscape and plays sound even with the silent switch on
